name: Twin Isovertex Pairing for Isopolyline Closure
definition: A procedure to close open isopolylines by finding a 'twin' isovertex p' for any isovertex p with valence one, allowing the addition of an iso-edge (p, p') to seal the polygon.
summary: Twin Isovertex Pairing closes open isopolylines into watertight meshes by pairing valence-one vertices via the existing edge-tree structure, avoiding tree refinement or scalar field modification.
